passage: The robotics club spent most of the school year building a robot that could sort recycling. The students in the club ______ their prototype at the regional science fair last spring.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: "Last spring" places the action in the past, so the past tense "presented" is needed.
source: Emir original item, written to the College Board Digital SAT content specifications
steps: "Last spring" is in the past, so the verb must be past tense.
"Presents" (present), "will present" (future) and "is presenting" (present progressive) clash with "last spring".
key: Verb tense: let time markers decide.
